name: Oak Creek Sport Horses
tagline: Exceptional Clydesdale × Thoroughbred sport horses, raised on the open pastures of Canada.
headline: Bred with patience. Developed with purpose.
preview_banner: Preview site · horses and text shown are samples
story_short: Aidan's story goes here: the family ranch in Canada, why she breeds this cross, foaling on pasture and how each horse is started. Written in her own words.
story_long: This page tells the Oak Creek story in Aidan's own words: where the ranch is, how it started, and why she chose the Clydesdale × Thoroughbred cross.
Our foals are born and raised on open pasture and grow up in a herd, where they learn manners, balance and confidence long before anyone sits on them.
Every horse is started slowly and given real-world miles (trails, water, trailers and show grounds) so the horse you watch on video is the horse that steps off the trailer.
buying: Bring your vet or use ours. We are happy to help arrange it.
See the horse move, tack up and ride, from anywhere.
Come meet the herd. Book a time that works for you.
We can recommend haulers and walk you through the paperwork, including border crossings.
